protocol: Exploratory within-category positive-vs-negative attribute ranking. Fixed seed 0, up to 4096 pairs per category-attribute unit; minimum 5 positives and 20 negatives. Macro over categories then attributes. Ties count 0.5 in ranking accuracy. Crop-only/fused-only exclude tied pairs. Positive-ROI short side bins are diagnostic, with differing unit composition; not a causal scale test. This metric is not official PACO AP.
